title: Foundation Models in Radiology: What, How, Why, and Why Not

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Foundation Models in Radiology: What, How, Why, and Why Not》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Thus, this review aims to explain the fundamental concepts and terms of FMs in radiology, with a specific focus on the requirements of training data, model training paradigms, model capabilities, and evaluation strategies.

sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Such models, typically referred to as foundation models (FMs), are trained on extensive corpora of unlabeled data and demonstrate high performance across various tasks.
